_comment: Raajkart College Books — Physics category. Collector created 2026-08-22 via bdata scraper create.
scraper_create_command: bdata scraper create "https://raajkart.com/books/college-books.html?c2c_college_books=7003" "For each book listing on the page, extract: product_name (book title as string), price (special/discounted price as a number, no currency symbol), currency (always 'INR' as string), in_stock (boolean, true if no Out of stock label is visible), product_url (the full URL of the book's detail page as string), scraped_at (current ISO timestamp as string)." --name undying-scraper-raajkart-physics
notes: Prices on site are shown as 'Special Price Rs X.XX' with a struck-through original price and a discount percentage. The special price is extracted as the canonical price. 'Out of stock' text is shown as plain text under items with no stock.
